_about: Which voice speaks for whom in the earbuds. A role is a project or a durable job; every name an agent
may announce itself with (inbox_post.sh --from, the ledger's project name) is listed as an alias, so a
rebuilt or renamed agent keeps its voice. 'role' is also what is spoken as the introduction ('<role> here.');
'role_fr', when present, is the name in French messages ('Un message de la tour de contrôle.'), with its
article (le, la, les, l'); without it the English name is used. Product names (reachy mini, micro duck,
open warlock) keep their English name.
Names not found here get the least used voice of the pool and are remembered in the untracked file
runtime/secretary/voices.learned.json (same format; move an entry here to make it permanent, or edit its voice).
This file is public: project and job names only. Voices must be in VOICE_POOL_EN of lib.sh, except the secretary's.
